findings.ac: Logic Layer: add the v4.3.0 reconcile.py hash to the scaffold pristine map (KNOWN_SHIPPED_SCRIPT_HASHES)
findings.text: No test checks that the new KNOWN_SHIPPED_SCRIPT_HASHES['.agents/scripts/reconcile.py'] entry matches the shipped script. In the snapshot, _versioning.body_hash(src/scripts/reconcile.py) (same as dist/skills/stratosphere-setup/scripts/reconcile.py) is 6d115aab...9884, while the entry added in scaffold.py is 8507cbfb...0d0e, so the shipped script is not recognised as 'known_shipped_version'. Nothing in tests/ would fail.

findings.ac: Unit test for --rebuild-indices on a tmp tree
findings.text: The rebuild_indices tests never assert the index line format or content: no assertion of `* [Title](/path.md) - description` from frontmatter, the `# <dirname>` header, that the stale nightly index.md ('stale') is overwritten, or that index.md and non-.md files such as .last-run.json are excluded. The idempotence test only compares run 1 to run 2, and the stem-fallback test covers only the no-description case. A regression that drops the description or title would pass.

findings.ac: 0d wording / Logic Layer: Phase 3.6 runs reconcile.py --all-open with no --require-gh
findings.text: test_calls_the_scripts_instead_of_reasoning only asserts the substring 'python .agents/scripts/reconcile.py --all-open', so appending --require-gh to the Phase 3.6 command would still pass. The issue states explicitly 'no --require-gh'. The 'N indices rebuilt' reporting line in Phase 3.5 is also not asserted.
